stem: Which line appears to have an x-intercept of -5 and a y-intercept of 3?
visual_elements: Graph F: Line passing through (-5,0) and (0,3) approximately.
Graph H: Line passing through positive x and negative y intercepts.
Graph G: Line passing through negative x and negative y intercepts.
Graph J: Line passing through positive x and negative y intercepts.
notes: Graphs labeled with letters F, H, G, J; answer is the graph with x-intercept at -5 and y-intercept at 3, visually identified as F.
